verdicts.decision_note: The client introduces the Big Block winner count, prize amount, affiliate selection, and ticket-weighted winning behavior.
The client changes the Big Block ticket counter, eligibility/reset rules, pool trigger, royalty funding behavior, and metadata presentation.
The client changes the Big Block to five $10,000 prizes every 50,000 sales; the updated top-level trigger and pool fields replace their prior values without requiring key deletion.
Target-specific implementation claim following the Big Block parameter change; the freelancer reports the implemented trigger and five $10,000 awards.
The client specifies that approximately 50,000 primary or secondary sales trigger the Big Block and that both sale types fund its pool.
The client establishes Chainlink VRF as the on-chain winner-selection mechanism for the Big Block.
The proposed fields restate the existing 50,000-sale trigger and previously established no-referral ticket allocation without a distinct requirement change.
The client changes the Big Block to one $10,000 winner every 10,000 sales; the updated count, pool total, and trigger replace the corresponding prior values.
Automatic prize delivery is a shared prize-claim behavior better owned by REQ_PRIZE_CLAIM_FLOW, not the independently scoped Big Block mechanism.
The client explicitly removes the entire Big Block mechanism; REMOVE correctly carries no value removals or other payload.
